summary: Integer row arithmetic raises when the result leaves the declared width; integer SUM overflow is reported as may-fail and checked while the job runs, not a proof failure.
note: Unnamed 'Decided (2026-11-01)'. The SUM half later became an inferred precondition checked on data or discharged by row bounds (#219, #580, #665); row arithmetic part stands. The Isthmus normalization part was withdrawn (#202 comment 6570531287).
